results.name: Argosy Company
results.description: Trade company that commands a fleet of beast-hunting ships and pays bounties on beasts to independent captains. Their unscrupulous merchants deal in trophies and resources gathered from slain creatures.

results.name: Eldarian Remnants
results.description: Loyalists of a fallen empire who seek to restore their former glory among the isles, guided by a charismatic and shrewd military leader. The sails of their ships are emblazoned with a burning phoenix.

results.name: Empire of Solas
results.description: Age-old dominion ruled by an immortal god-emperor. Their ostentatious ships are adorned with gold metalwork and filigreed sails.

results.name: Firgovian Regency
results.description: Fracturing empire facing a succession crisis in the aftermath of the monarch’s assassination. Rival claimants gather their armies and navies to take the crown by force.

results.name: Hand of Theya
results.description: Iron-fisted theocracy under the rule of a council of priests. Their mandates are enforced by red-robed inquisitors.

results.name: Kyrody Dominion
results.description: Expansive empire with far-flung territories. Their holdings within the isles are overseen by corrupt and squabbling governors, each vying for greater power and wealth.

results.name: Meridian Company
results.description: Powerful trade company with diverse holdings and boundless political influence. They function as a shadow government behind other powers.

results.name: Norish Empire
results.description: War-mongering clans newly united under a powerful warlord. Their warships are fitted with imposing rams and heavy boarding ramps.

results.name: Skulde Alliance
results.description: Ambitious empire that wields a powerful military. At the vanguard of their fleets are the dragon-riders of the Crimson Guard, who house their steeds and launch their attacks from colossal carrier ships.

results.name: Sovereign States
results.description: Industrialist power formed from the remnants of warring nations. They are governed by an oligarchical council whose members scheme and backstab to advance their own interests.
